tmpdir.description: Directory where backup scripts are stored and executed from.

logdir.description: Directory where individual backup logs are stored.

masterlogfile.description: Centralized log file for backupninja run events.

emailresults.description: Enable or disable email notifications about backup results.

emailto.description: Email address to receive backup reports (used if email results are enabled).

smtpserver.description: SMTP server hostname for sending email notifications.

smtpport.description: SMTP server port (e.g., 25 for plain, 587 for STARTTLS, 465 for SSL).

smtptls.description: SMTP security mode: 0 = none, 1 = TLS, 2 = SSL.

smtpfrom.description: From address used in notification emails.

retention_days.description: Default retention period (in days) for local backups. Set to 0 to disable automatic cleanup.

maxjobs.description: Maximum number of concurrent backup jobs. Prevents resource exhaustion on the host.

dryrun.description: Run in simulation mode (no changes made). Useful for testing.

actions.description: List of backup actions to schedule and run. Each action defines a script name, optional schedule, and arguments.

name.description: Name of the backup script (e.g., 'rsync', 'duplicity', 'mysql-backup.sh'). Must exist in tmpdir or be fully qualified.

when.description: Cron-style schedule (e.g., '0 2 * * *' for daily at 2 AM). If omitted, the action runs once per backupninja invocation.

options.description: List of additional arguments passed to the backup script.

description.description: Human-readable description of the action (used in inline comments).
